subject: The history of salt: salt-hungry mountain goats in Olympic National Park, sodium and chloride in the body, solar evaporation ponds, brine boiling in China, Hallstatt salt mines in Austria, food preservation, taste, Saharan salt caravans traded for gold in West Africa, Roman salarium, salt cellars and medieval banquets, the French gabelle and the Revolution, Gandhi's Salt March 1930, industrial salt, Morton Salt 1911
title: L’histoire du sel

comment.question: Et vous, quel est l’aliment que vous ne mangeriez jamais sans sel ?
